evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
evidence: Fresh recomputation from all 107 fixture rows produced 107 unique status URLs, Posts=106, Replies=107, union=107, and profile gap=110-107=3; the supplied candidate fingerprint also recomputed exactly.

Row-derived publication metrics match the fixture: 86 originals, 6 replies, 15 reposts; 92 @CallNYCApp-authored records; 71 Council-recognition records crediting 26 distinct handles; 75 deep-link occurrences, 62 distinct paths, 16 non-API service domains, and one API path. Every per-domain occurrence and unique-path subtotal also matched.

The Council-engagement union recomputes to eight accounts: four incoming Council-office authors plus five timeline repost authors, with Peter Koo overlapping. The resulting union is Margaret Chin, Ruben Wills, Steven Matteo, Peter Koo, Mathieu Eugene, Helen Rosenthal, Rosie Mendez, and Ydanis Rodriguez.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/fixtures/callnyc-full-population.json:749-756 preserves the May 19, 2016 @CarlinaRivera repost as a row. docs/knowledge-bank/projects/social-media-production.md:84-86 explicitly excludes it because Rivera was not then serving as a Council Member; she is absent from the eight-source claim evidence.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/social-media-production.ts:1118-1172 gives each of the eight named accounts direct source support and expressly rejects endorsement, official adoption, and constituent-service causality.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/social-media-production.ts:1225-1235 distinguishes institutional publishing from Jamie: credited handles are a publishing-pattern measure, interaction totals are not impact metrics, and no @CallNYCApp post is personally attributed to Jamie without authorship evidence.

apps/www/src/content/work/callnyc.mdx:59-69 separately names Jamie's direct product actions—building the prototype, organizing issue pathways, and translating administrative categories—while lines 75-91 introduce institutional-account findings as evidence rather than personal authorship.
Fresh Node 26 verification passed 35/35 citation and knowledge-development tests with zero failures; the independent assertion script ended AUDIT_OK.
findings: Direct product action, institutional publishing, Council-account engagement, collective credit, and causality remain distinct.
The eight-account engagement result is a conservative row-and-source-backed union, not a count of all 26 officials credited by the account.
The Carlina Rivera repost is preserved rather than erased and explicitly excluded from the historical Council-member count.
No interaction count is converted into reach, endorsement, adoption, service impact, or Jamie-specific authorship.
evals.recommended_next_move: Preserve the current authorship and causality boundaries; keep the three unrecovered profile records open as research and re-evaluate counts only if stable status-level evidence is recovered.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
evidence: The independent row audit reproduced the complete URL inventory: 94 records with external links, 98 link occurrences, 84 distinct short URLs, 89 @CallNYCApp-authored link occurrences, and 75 distinct authored short URLs.
The 11-row incoming stakeholder inventory is unique by status URL and recomputes to four council-office, one incidental-network, two legal-services, two resident, and two civic-technology records.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/social-media-production.ts:1179-1238 selects the public-guidance claim and limits it to 62 distinct service/API paths, 16 service domains, 107 materialized records, a three-record gap, and bounded curation examples.

A fresh runtime call to resolveCitationOccurrence("callnyc", "social-public-guidance") through apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/public.ts:75-133 resolved the active /work/callnyc projection and exactly five rendered sources: the population fixture plus MSL Legal, Participatory Politics, Gizmodo, and Gothamist examples.

The [immutable GitHub fixture](https://github.com/openhouse/jamieburk.art/blob/ff2a8a555bc91c05b75551aa59bd488133af74e7/apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/fixtures/callnyc-full-population.json) returned HTTP 200 during live review. The local ff2a8a555bc91c05b75551aa59bd488133af74e7 commit object contains the identical fixture SHA-256, 1597295a82fb4a99d87e47148bc57f4b02aec5709894d470b6590629a34d92c5.

apps/www/src/content/work/callnyc.mdx:30-69 gives a hiring reader the problem, Jamie's action, resident-facing purpose, and usable result; lines 93-113 translate the work into civic-tech, product-operations, and implementation value while preserving archived/unofficial and historical-data limits.

docs/knowledge-bank/projects/social-media-production.md:96-100 keeps volatile replies, reposts, likes, and interaction units out of headline copy and explicitly denies reach, conversion, endorsement, or service impact.

Fresh Node 26 verification passed 35/35 citation and knowledge-development tests with zero failures; the independent fingerprint, population, publication, URL, stakeholder, union, exclusion, and resolver audit ended AUDIT_OK.
findings: The narrative gives a hiring reader a clear action, purpose, usable product result, transferable operating pattern, and honest archival limits.
The 62-path and eight-account figures function as reproducible evidence of product structure and bounded public response, not metric theater.
The selected public claim resolves through the production resolver and cites both the immutable population fixture and concrete bounded examples.
The unrecovered three-record gap remains conspicuous and tasked rather than being hidden behind a misleading 100% claim.
evals.recommended_next_move: Retain the selected projection and explicit 107-of-110 boundary; add the public-guidance occurrence to the existing resolver regression-test table so its five-source citation contract is guarded directly.
